name: bi-property-transactions
description: Prepare a Burundi property acquisition, mortgage-registration or electronic-title workpaper for calendar 2026. This Guide separates the January and July budget periods, identifies the purchaser’s property wealth tax, calculates the statutory mortgage charge and electronic-title fee, and keeps urban building-permit tax separate from transfer costs. It also identifies the principal land-registration valuation, notarial, notification and security-document rules. Rental income and the seller’s income-tax gain belong to their existing Guides. The current transfer-tariff order, geographic title-category assignment, actual title application form, complete conveyancing invoice and annual land-tax computation remain unresolved. This partial draft passed independent AI source review within its stated scope, with no accountant attestation.
